topic: Composite repair - procedure and safety precautions while working of composites.
syllabus_extract: Composite repair - procedure and safety precautions while working of composites.
specific_objectives: 28.1.3.5 Trainee will be able to explain Composite repair procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of composite repair procedure steps and safety gear usage; Instructor supervision of safety protocols.
intro_questions: What are the primary hazards associated with composite materials?
List the standard personal protective equipment required for composite work.
Define the term 'delamination' in the context of composite structures.

topics: Handling of resin and hardener chemicals
development.content:
Safety precautions during composite handling
Personal protective equipment requirements
Ventilation and fire safety measures
Handling of resin and hardener chemicals

Surface preparation and cleaning procedures
Lay-up techniques and resin application
Curing processes and environmental controls
Post-cure inspection and quality checks

Documentation of repair procedures
Common defects and their identification
Waste disposal of composite materials
Final acceptance criteria for repairs

summary_questions: Explain the critical steps involved in the composite repair procedure.
Describe the safety precautions necessary when working with composite resins.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the composite repair procedure to be discussed in the next lesson plan (LP 02).
